description: Use docker compose to build the course image and run it as the cs357 service, entering an interactive shell.

steps.description: Three commands for Option B: plain Docker Compose entry.
Directory: cd to .devcontainer folder containing the Dockerfile and compose file.
Build: docker compose build creates the cs357 image from the Dockerfile.
Run: docker compose run --rm cs357 starts the container and opens a shell inside it.
